evidence: Changes .github/workflows/ci.yml and multiple ci/test/ scripts to replace FreeBSD cross-compilation with native VM testing.
rationale: Enables per-PR native CI testing on FreeBSD to prevent platform regressions from reaching master. The description notes that recent BSD regressions were caught only reactively in external nightlies (#36078 and #36145), and reviewers agreed that running tests in Core CI is needed to reliably support the platform.
